blocks.name: Future Trunks (base form, Capsule Corp jacket, sword on the back) - playable fighter
blocks.notes: Cells are 32x32 on the #47ffbb/#34bc88 checker; the surround #2a966c and the empty-cell border #237f5a are background. The RIGHT row is the horizontal mirror of the LEFT row (the build dedupes it). Up col 1 is empty (no back-view blink). Order: 0 idle, 1 blink, 2-5 walk, 6-9 run, 10-13 / 14-17 / 18-21 the three melee strings (wind-up, hit with white swoosh, follow-through, recover; the third string is a spinning kick, so punch3 and kick share 18-21), 22-28 sword charged melee (22 reach for the hilt, 23 draw with an arc trail, 24 blade held low, 25-26 leap with the sword overhead - no baked shadow, 27 downward cleave with a big arc, 28 blade resting on the ground), 29 ki wind-up (body twisted back), 30/31 alternate-hand palm thrusts (loop 30-31 for rapid fire), 32-35 quick-draw sword slash special (32 steps back and grabs the hilt over the shoulder, 33 lunges drawing the blade, 34 wide slash with a circular arc, 35 follow-through with the blade extended), 36 hit flinch (eyes shut, white hit spark at the head), 37-38 crouched guard behind raised fists (37 carries the block spark, 38 is the held pose), 39 fists-clenched power-up stance (the engine aura goes on top), 40-43 the level-up / emote slot (40-41 with white sparkles, 42-43 without; 41 and 43 are both hands on the head from the front and a hand rubbing the back of the head from the side - a sheepish head scratch; same slot as goku.json levelUp), 44-47 level flight with the whole body drawn (feet trailing behind/above the head, hair fluttering; no baked shadow), 48-51 diagonal flight (no baked shadow): the DOWN row flies down-right, LEFT row down-left, RIGHT row up-left and UP row up-right (back views), exported as flyDownRight / flyDownLeft / flyUpLeft / flyUpRight with the single sheet row each uses, 52-55 knock-down in the side rows only (52 doubled over, 53 falling onto the hands, 54-55 flat on the ground). Down-row 52 = standing with hands on the hips, down-row 53 = both arms raised straight up (the only 'raise' cell, so raise is front-facing only). Down-only cutscene cells: 54 one arm raised to the hilt behind the head, 55 sword drawn and held upright (drawSword), 56-57 both hands on the hilt with the blade pointing down / tip planted (swordRest), 58-61 Super Saiyan transformation (58 head bowed with arms flung out, 59 screaming with the hair flashing gold, 60 golden hair with the jacket lit blue, 61 golden hair - continue on future_trunks_super_saiyan.png), 62-63 dead with a halo (hair stirring). Down-row col 64 and every other cell right of col 55 (side rows) / col 51 (up row) are empty; cols 65-70 are the separate long-haired block. Cells with no baked shadow: 25-26 (leap), 44-51 (flight) and down-row 59-63. Palette: white (#ffffff) is shared by hair highlights, eye whites, the blade edge and every baked effect (swooshes, sparkles); #ad4a00 is shared by boots and sheath, #c69452 by skin and boot highlights, the greys by trousers and blade; #ad7b39 is a skin mid-tone here but is the golden-hair outline in cells 59-61; the waist band uses #2184ff / #ff9418 / #ffd642 accents. 'halo' only occurs in 62-63.

blocks.name: Future Trunks with long hair (first arrival) - cutscene character
blocks.notes: Long-haired Future Trunks as he first appears (arrival / meeting Goku). Six cells at cols 65-70 of future_trunks.png (origin x 2080), DOWN and LEFT rows only - right is the mirror of left, there is no back view. Down row: 0 idle, 1 blink, 2-5 walk (step, pass, step, pass). Left row: 0 idle, 1 blink, then 2-5 is the sheepish head-scratch emote of the main block's 40-43 (2-3 with white sparkles, 4-5 without; 3 and 5 rub the back of the head), so the left row has no walk cycle (the side walk falls back to idle). Same palette as the short-haired block; the long hair uses the hair ramp.
